newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian CLB says fraud has no impact on earnings.
newsitem.headline: Belgian CLB says fraud has no impact on earnings.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Belgium (CLB), a unit of French Credit Lyonnais, said on Monday the discovery of a major fraud against the bank earlier this year would have no impact on future earnings.

"The bank had an excellent commercial and financial health in 1996. This trend continued in the first months of 1997 despite the fact the bank was the victim of a large-scale fraud...The commercial and financial consequences of that unhappy event are under control so that they will have no impact on future earnings," CLB said in a statement.
The bank said in March a former employee had stolen 3.5 billion Belgian francs. The ex-employee and her husband have since been arrested.
CLB said 1996 net profit jumped to 821 million Belgian francs in 1996 from 628 million a year earlier. Profit was 383 million francs in the first quarter of 1997, it added.
